scenes.heading: INT. RENTAL HOUSE KITCHEN - DAWN
scenes.summary: Maya discovers the missing evidence ledger before the town wakes.
scenes.excerpt: A coffee maker clicks off. Maya turns the ledger toward the first blue light at the window.

scenes.heading: EXT. ALBUQUERQUE MOTEL - DAY
scenes.summary: Eli arrives with a damaged pickup and a warning for Maya.
scenes.excerpt: The pickup rolls into the empty lot on a soft tire. Eli leaves the engine running.

scenes.heading: INT. MOTEL ROOM - DAY
scenes.summary: Maya and Eli map a route to the transmitter site.
scenes.excerpt: Maya draws one hard line across the county map and circles the old service road.

scenes.heading: EXT. SERVICE ROAD - DAY
scenes.summary: The pickup is followed through the industrial fringe.
scenes.excerpt: A white utility van holds two car lengths back as the skyline disappears in dust.

scenes.heading: INT. PICKUP TRUCK - DAY
scenes.summary: Eli admits the transmitter holds more than the missing files.
scenes.excerpt: Eli watches the mirror. Maya folds the map small enough to hide beneath the seat.

scenes.heading: EXT. GAS STATION - DUSK
scenes.summary: Deputy Cole blocks the only fuel pump and questions the pair.
scenes.excerpt: Cole rests one hand on the pump. The sunset burns in the pickup's cracked windshield.

scenes.heading: INT. GAS STATION - DUSK
scenes.summary: Maya copies a security-camera timestamp while Eli distracts Cole.
scenes.excerpt: The receipt printer chatters. Maya photographs the monitor reflection in the freezer door.

scenes.heading: EXT. DESERT OVERLOOK - NIGHT
scenes.summary: Maya confirms the transmitter is active across the valley.
scenes.excerpt: A red pulse answers from the far ridge. Maya counts the interval against her watch.

scenes.heading: INT. SHERIFF SUBSTATION - NIGHT
scenes.summary: Cole deletes a dispatch record and calls an unknown handler.
scenes.excerpt: The dispatch row vanishes. Cole locks the terminal before the call connects.

scenes.heading: EXT. BACK ALLEY - NIGHT
scenes.summary: Maya trades the copied timestamp for access codes.
scenes.excerpt: Jo slides a key card beneath the workshop door. A cruiser turns the next corner.

scenes.heading: INT. WORKSHOP - DAWN
scenes.summary: Jo rigs the pickup to carry a portable receiver.
scenes.excerpt: Jo seats the final cable and the receiver wakes with a low amber glow.

scenes.heading: EXT. RAILYARD EDGE - DAY
scenes.summary: The team tests the receiver beneath active freight lines.
scenes.excerpt: A freight horn swallows the first signal. Maya raises the antenna and tries again.

scenes.heading: INT. PICKUP TRUCK - DAY
scenes.summary: Maya commits to the exposed desert route despite Cole's pursuit.
scenes.excerpt: The receiver locks onto the pulse. Maya points toward the road running alone into the basin.

scenes.heading: EXT. DESERT ACCESS ROAD - DAY
scenes.summary: Maya and Eli race the transmitter shutdown across an exposed desert road.
scenes.excerpt: The pickup climbs through a veil of dust. Ahead, the transmitter pulse begins to slow.
